item.description: 据报道，英特尔已获得微软的一笔重要订单。微软或将采用英特尔代工的18A或18A-P工艺为其制造下一代AI处理器。这是英特尔代工在18A节点上首次确认的重大外部客户订单。

item.title: A Two-Mirror Faceted Projection System for EUV Lithography
item.description: arXiv:2609.11299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose an all-reflective two-mirror projection system for extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography operating at exposure wavelengths of $13.5$~nm (Mo/Si) and $11.2$~nm (Ru/Be), delivering a fourfold ($4\times$) demagnification of the periodic mask pattern at a numerical aperture approaching unity ($\mathrm{NA}_{\max} \approx 0.993$). item.title: On-chip squeezed light in the audio frequency band
item.description: arXiv:2609.11004v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Squeezed light in the audio-frequency band is a key resource for quantum metrology and quantum sensing. However, realizing stable audio-frequency squeezed light on integrated photonic platforms remains challenging due to technical noise and the difficulty of scalable phase referencing.
